reason: In a side-plank (Copenhagen-style) hip adduction the bottom-leg adductors lift the whole torso off the floor, so the resistance is bodyweight through a long body lever, not the free weight of a limb.
The catalog already has loaded_cossack_squat and weighted_cossack_squats as the loaded entries, so "Deep Cossack Squat" is the unloaded mobility variant and should not require a weight to be logged.
The deep (unloaded) Cossack squat has no implement to log, and the loaded variants exist as separate exercise codes.
